cell_line.evidence: U2OS/NOD2 RIPK2 KO cells were generated using CRISPR/Cas9 KO plasmids (containing gRNA, Cas9, and EGFP reporter; Santa Cruz Biotechnology) as described in Elliott et al (2016).
inferred: For nanoBRET experiments in HEKBlue cells, cells were transfected with NanoLuc‐RIPK2 WT and stimulated with 1 ng/ml L18‐MDP for 1 h prior to the inhibitor addition.

HEK293 cells were transiently transfected with the NanoLuc‐RIPK2 WT and T95W mutant RIPK2 constructs, plated into white 384‐well assay plates (Corning, Corning, NY), treated with serial dilutions of SGC‐590001, and incubated with 1 μM ponatinib or DMSO control for 3 h.
inferred: For nanoBRET experiments in HEKBlue cells, cells were transfected with NanoLuc‐RIPK2 WT and stimulated with 1 ng/ml L18‐MDP for 1 h prior to the inhibitor addition.
inferred: For HEKBlue assay, cells were seeded into clear 96‐well plates at 7.5 × 103 cells/well and allowed to attach for 48 h.

For THP1Blue assay, 1 × 105 cells were seeded in 200 μl of RPMI media in 96‐well plates and treated with inhibitors in 0.5 μl DMSO for 15 min prior to the addition of 10 μg/ml MDP, 10 ng/ml Pam3CSK4, 10 ng/ml E. coli LPS, or 1 × 107 cells/ml heat‐killed L. monocytogenes (InvivoGen) for 24 h.
